title: Repertoire: Tiger Rag, Bugle Call Rag, blues and Hesitation Blues
summary: Jazz standards and the blues were always in the repertoire, with songs like Gin Mill Blues and Little Rock Getaway. He recalls a hillbilly name for Hesitation Blues.
